description: Source code for MultiTouchMotionAccumulator class handling multi-touch input events in Android, including configuration, processing, and slot management.

classes.name: MultiTouchMotionAccumulator
classes.description: Handles accumulation and processing of multi-touch input events, managing touch slots and tracking touch data.

classes.name: MultiTouchMotionAccumulator::Slot
classes.description: Represents individual touch slots with properties for touch attributes and tool type.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the accumulator with device context, slot count, and protocol usage.

methods.name: resetSlots
methods.description: Resets all touch slots to initial state.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes raw input events to update touch slot data.

methods.name: finishSync
methods.description: Finalizes the current sync cycle, resetting slots if not using slots protocol.

methods.name: warnIfNotInUse
methods.description: Logs a warning if an event is received for a slot not marked as in use.

methods.name: MultiTouchMotionAccumulator::Slot::getToolType
methods.description: Returns the tool type (finger, stylus, palm, unknown) based on slot data.
